title: User selects an active authority framework and starts a new Intelli Audit through to the workspace
description: Full happy-path journey: /intelli-audit lists authority frameworks sourced from Smart Compliance, clicking into one opens /intelli-audit/[frameworkId], and 'Start New Audit' creates the audit and redirects into the workspace.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with pre_audit.read and audit.create
A project is selected in the project switcher
At least one framework is an active authority framework for the project (Smart Compliance)
steps: Navigate to /intelli-audit and confirm the framework appears in the 'Active Frameworks' tab table
Click 'View Details' on the framework row
On /intelli-audit/[frameworkId], click 'Start New Audit'
Fill title (>= 3 chars) and description (>= 10 chars) in the create modal and submit
expectedResult: Toast shows 'Success' / 'Intelligent audit created successfully'; browser redirects to /intelli-audit/[frameworkId]/[newAuditId] and the Phase 1 workspace loads with 'Phase 1 of 4' shown in the progress banner.

title: Phase 1 completion silently degrades to a retryable Phase 2 recommendation state when the IACR service fails
description: completeTacticalSection swallows any error from generatePhase2Recommendations (intelligent-audit.controller.js:1504-1509) and still returns HTTP 200 with message 'Tactical + Phase 1 completed. Phase 2 recommendation generation needs retry.' instead of surfacing an error. The UI must show the retry banner rather than silently presenting an empty, unexplained Phase 2.
preconditions: Audit is in Phase 1 with all CFRS/strategic/tactical questions answered
The Python IACR service (/qre/controls) is made to fail or time out (30s) for this request
steps: Complete the final tactical question to trigger Phase 1 completion
Observe the Phase 1 completion response/toast
Navigate to Phase 2 (Framework Controls)
expectedResult: Phase 1 still completes successfully (no user-facing error on the completion step). Phase 2 shows the red 'AI recommendation generation needs retry' alert with the IACR error text (or fallback 'The canonical requirement catalogue could not be resolved.') and a visible 'Retry' button; recommendedControls is empty until retried.

title: User adds a manual control, deselects an AI-suggested control, and completes Phase 2 with the resulting selection
preconditions: Phase 2 recommendationGeneration.status is 'ready' with at least 2 AI-suggested controls
Logged in as a user with audit.update
steps: On the Phase 2 'Framework Controls' screen, uncheck one AI-suggested control in the 'Recommended Controls' table
In the 'Available Controls' table, click the '+' add icon on a control not yet in scope
Confirm the new control appears in 'Recommended Controls' tagged 'Manually Added' and the 'Selected' stat count updates
Click 'Complete Phase 2 ({n} controls selected)'
expectedResult: The deselected control is excluded and the manually added control is included in the finalized scope; after completion the screen shows the read-only banner '✓ Phase 2 completed' / 'Control recommendations have been finalized. This view is read-only.' and Phase 3 becomes unlockable.

title: Complete Phase 3 button stays disabled until every initialized control has been assessed
steps: Click 'Initialize Phase 3' and confirm 3 assessment controls are created, evidence from Phase 1 auto-linked where relevant
Assess 2 of the 3 controls, leaving 1 as 'Not Started'
Observe the 'Complete Phase 3' button state
Assess the final control
Click 'Complete Phase 3'
expectedResult: While 1 control is unassessed, 'Complete Phase 3' remains disabled (completedControls < totalControls). Once all 3 are assessed the button becomes enabled and clicking it shows '✓ Phase 3 completed successfully' / 'Pre-assessment has been completed. 3 controls assessed.'

title: Running gap analysis surfaces all 7 gap types across controls and blocks completion until every gap is resolved
description: runGapAnalysis (intelligent-audit.controller.js:3449-3517) can produce Missing Evidence, Failed Findings, Not Assessed, Revision Required, Low Client Coverage, Integration Failure, No Policy Coverage, and Vendor Risk gaps on the same control, each contributing to a clamped riskScore that drives priority/severity.
preconditions: At least one control has zero evidence attachments and a failed finding
steps: On Phase 4, click 'Run Analysis'
Wait for the success toast 'Analysis Complete' / 'Gap analysis has been completed'
Open the 'Open Gaps' tab and inspect a control that had both 0 evidence and 1+ failed findings
Attempt to click 'Complete Audit' while gaps remain open
expectedResult: The gap for that control lists both 'Missing Evidence' and 'Failed Findings' in gapTypes. 'Complete Audit' is disabled/blocked with toast 'Cannot Complete' / 'There are still {n} unresolved gaps' while any gap is open.

title: Completing an audit with compliance score below 50% requires an explicit 'Complete Anyway' confirmation
preconditions: Computed compliance score for the audit is below 50%
steps: Resolve every open gap so the 'Complete Audit' button becomes enabled
Click 'Complete Audit'
expectedResult: An AlertDialog titled 'Low Compliance Score' appears with body text "Your compliance score is {score}%, which is below the recommended 50% threshold. Completing the audit with a low score may indicate insufficient remediation. Are you sure you want to proceed?" and 'Go Back' / 'Complete Anyway' buttons. Clicking 'Complete Anyway' finalizes the audit and shows 'Audit Complete' / 'Congratulations! Your audit is now complete.'

title: Creating a second Intelli Audit for the same framework and project succeeds silently with no duplicate warning
description: createIntelligentAudit (intelligent-audit.controller.js:704-863) has no query for an existing non-archived IntelligentAudit on the same frameworkId+projectId before creating a new one, and CreatePreAuditModal.jsx has no duplicate-check UI. This captures the current (permissive) behavior as a deliberate baseline pending a product decision.
preconditions: An in-progress Intelli Audit 'Audit A' already exists for Framework F / Project P
steps: Navigate to /intelli-audit/[F's frameworkId]
Click 'Start New Audit' and create 'Audit B' with the same framework and project
Observe any warning dialog or blocking behavior
expectedResult: No duplicate-audit warning is shown anywhere in the create flow; 'Audit B' is created (HTTP 201) and both 'Audit A' and 'Audit B' appear side-by-side in the framework's audits table with independent phase progress.

title: A completed Intelli Audit imports into Audit Assurance with assessmentStatus reset but sourceAssessmentStatus preserved
description: AuditAssuranceService.importFromIntelliAudit (audit-assurance.service.js:87-215) requires the source audit's Phase 4 to be complete and every Phase 3 control to carry a canonical frameworkRequirementId. Each created AuditScopeItem hardcodes assessmentStatus='not_started' while separately copying the original status into sourceAssessmentStatus.
preconditions: Intelli Audit 'Audit A' has Phase 4 fully completed (phaseStatus.phase4.isCompleted=true) with at least one Phase 3 control whose assessmentStatus is 'Completed'
Logged in as a user with audit-assurance creation permission
steps: In Audit Assurance, create a new engagement and choose 'Import from Intelli Audit', selecting 'Audit A'
Submit the import
Open the newly created audit-assurance scope item corresponding to the Phase 3 control that was 'Completed' in Intelli Audit
expectedResult: Import succeeds; the created AuditScopeItem has assessmentStatus='not_started' (reset) while sourceAssessmentStatus='Completed' (the original Intelli Audit status is preserved in the audit-trail field only) and sourceType='intelli_audit'. importSummary.pclVersion is null since PCL is retired.

title: Import from Intelli Audit is rejected when the source audit's Phase 4 is not yet completed
preconditions: Intelli Audit 'Audit C' exists for the same org/project/framework but phaseStatus.phase4.isCompleted is false
steps: In Audit Assurance, attempt to create a new engagement importing from Intelli Audit 'Audit C'
expectedResult: Response is 400 with message 'Selected Intelli Audit must be Phase 4 complete and use canonical requirements in the same organization, project, and framework'; no AuditAssurance or AuditScopeItem documents are created.

title: Fresh project with no authority frameworks activated shows the correct empty state, not a blank or errored table
preconditions: A newly created project with zero frameworks marked active in Smart Compliance
steps: Select the fresh project in the project switcher
Navigate to /intelli-audit
expectedResult: The 'Active Frameworks' table renders the empty message 'No active frameworks found. Please set authority frameworks in Smart Compliance.' — no error toast, no console exception, and the search box/count still render ('0 framework(s) found').
